# Vendored browser libraries

These files are local copies of third-party bundles loaded by `business-finances.html`. They provide workbook/CSV imports, spreadsheet/PDF/Word exports, charts, and icons. The original licence and attribution comments remain in each file. Change or replace these bundles from their upstream projects; application logic belongs in `../js/`.

Keep the `<script>` dependency order in the HTML entry point. The IAP modules load after these libraries.
